thread:
Lena: quick pulse before KPI review: launch posts last week drove a big traffic bump but dashboard shows CTR->demo funnel is off across paid channels. anyone tracking channel-level conv? :mag:
Ben: seeing it too. paid search raw clicks up 45% but demo starts down 30%. organic social stable. link to current dashboard: https://dash.redwood/marketing/launch-ops
Priya: could be attribution noise. did GA4 attribution window change or did we flip to data-driven? I remember a tag update on friday.
analytics-bot: tag-update: ga4.measurement.update applied by Diego at 2024-11-18T18:02Z. fields changed: session_timeout=30m, attribution_model=data-driven.
Diego: I pushed the GA4 update to fix session stitching for cross-domain. Sorry if that disrupted the demo attribution counts.
Lena: ok note that. we need to separate: 1) true conversion drop vs 2) attribution model artifact. can someone run a cohort compare (pre-upd vs post-upd)?
Ben: running a quick cohort slice. SQL Im using (simplified):
```sql
select channel, count(*) as clicks, sum(demo_started::int) as demos, round(sum(demo_started::int)/count(*)::numeric,3) as conv
from marketing.clicks
where campaign in ('launch-dec2024') and created_at between '2024-11-10' and '2024-11-18'
group by channel;
```
Ben: pre-update (11/10-11/17): paid-search 5,200 clicks -> 312 demos (6.0%); post-update (11/18): paid-search 2,700 clicks -> 81 demos (3.0%).
Priya: that looks like a real conv drop, not just attribution. any creative or landing changes on 11/18?
Diego: we pushed new headline variants to /launch-hero at 11/18 17:45Z. A/B test split 70/30. variant B is shorter copy.
Lena: hmm feels similar to the webinar case (shorter hero increases signups but fewer demos). Do we have landing copy breakdown by demo?
Ben: adding msg_version to the slice now.
Ben: quick results: variant A (original): 3,200 clicks -> 240 demos (7.5%); variant B (short): 4,700 clicks -> 153 demos (3.2%). Variant B increased clicks but lowered demo conversion.
Priya: tradeoff again. For launch narrative we should capture both: reach uplift vs demo intent loss. This matters for the benchmark doc where we compare launch posts across channels.
Lena: agree. action plan for KPI email: - call out channel-by-channel conv change, - note GA4 attribution switch as context, - recommend holdout on variant B for paid channels for 7 days, - add a dashboard tile showing msg_version and channel cross-breakdown.
Diego: I can revert the A/B allocation on paid-search to favor original A 80/20 for the holdout. want me to do that now?
Ben: yes please. Also can we get a short-term cohort metric: MQL->Demo and Demo->Paid for both variants? that's a better downstream signal than demo-start alone.
analytics-bot: job submitted: cohort-run for metrics [MQL_to_Demo, Demo_to_Paid] for campaign=launch-dec2024, variations=[A,B]. expected completion ~15m.
Priya: for the benchmarks doc, I'll write a short narrative: "Variant B broadened reach (+35% clicks) but reduced demo intent (-57% conv), indicating messaging dilutes high-intent signal; recommend holdout and downstream qualification check before defaulting B."
Lena: perfect. also add a note to the weekly KPI review deck: "Attribution model changed 11/18; raw numbers reflect both model and creative effects."
Ben: small dashboard ask: show a 14-day rolling conv by channel + msg_version and flag >20% week-over-week delta. Jules (cc) can you add? cc @Jules
Diego: revert done. monitoring allocation and paid campaigns.
analytics-bot: cohort job complete. results uploaded: s3://redwood-analytics/cohorts/launch-dec2024/variants_A_B_20241118.csv
Priya: downloaded. preliminary: Variant B -> MQL_to_Demo 0.14 vs A 0.28; Demo_to_Paid B 0.08 vs A 0.12. downstream less favorable for B.
Lena: thanks. next steps: 1) include bench narrative in launch retrospective, 2) holdout B on paid for 7 days, 3) add msg_version dims to dashboards, 4) callout GA4 change in KPI email. I'll draft the KPI blurb and circulate.
SalesOps: FYI passed to sales ops - we'll watch demo quality.
Lena: ok team, tagging this for the KPI sync tomorrow at 09:30. thanks :raised_hands: end.
